decisions.reason: A core navigation and observation camera with its own page in both years meets the aspiration based on the firm's heritage, so there is no trigger for problemistic search.
A modular multi-model navigation camera line, close to the core business and steadily presented, fits the firm's direction toward flexible sensors and performs at aspiration.
The space situational awareness suite extends the established offer into a growing market, and the slack of a large firm allows it to carry the product while results mature.

The miniaturized LiDAR has only been mentioned rather than featured, which suggests modest traction, but it fits the firm's push toward small satellites and docking, so slack and long space sales cycles justify keeping it.
The newly launched radiation-hard camera line has its own page and is close to core competence, so it is too early for any shortfall against aspiration to appear.
The asteroid navigation camera is likely tied to specific agency missions with long horizons, so despite only a brief mention, its strategic value and the firm's slack argue for keeping it.
